description: Create a new product attribute named 'finish_color' with the Label 'Finish Color'. Set the Catalog Input Type to 'Visual Swatch'. Create three options with specific hex colors: 'Matte Black' (#2C2C2C), 'Brushed Gold' (#D4AF37), and 'Polished Chrome' (#E6E6FA). Configure the attribute to be Filterable (with results) in Layered Navigation, visible on Catalog Pages on Storefront, and used in Search Results Layered Navigation. Save the attribute. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
